model_visible.title: meta-data 118
model_visible.intro: 这是一道元谜题。题面只有喂入词和原题留下的说明。用 submit_answer 提交答案。不要打开其他网站。

static.prompt:
The meta title is Too Little to Do.
You think to yourself how you wanted to go to the local museum today, for example, or maybe apply for some jobs. But there's so much info online!
喂入词：
CIRQUE DU SOLEIL
CROSSING OVER
DEMOGORGONS
GHOST IN THE SHELL
GUY SMILEY
LUNCHEONETTES
TRAGICOMIC
用 submit_answer 提交一个答案。

notes_for_report: 来自 Caltech 2018。答案只在裁判哈希里。完整数据文件不交给模型。
